## Dispositions

**P9 — executable performance protocol.** P-4 is now two checks that cannot be conflated. **P-4a** (sequential latency): 20 alternating 100%/200% commits, each issued only after the prior visible render settled, sample = commit → last visible `renderSettle(completed)`, ascending sort, p95 = 19th of 20, ≤ 500 ms — no `renderCancel` required or expected, absence explicitly not a failure. **P-4b** (deliberate overlap): commit, prove in-flight by polling `__gnoPdfMetrics` for an unsettled `renderStart` (escalate render cost if it settles too fast; fail loudly if in-flight is never observable; never degrade to a sleep), then commit the replacement and assert `renderCancel → renderSettle(cancelled)` before the replacement's `renderStart`, no later completed settle on the superseded generation, no stale paint; ≥ 2 runs with the ordered event stream stored. Task .3 also forbids synthesizing a cancel for an already-terminal task.

**P10 — observed PDF.js auxiliary-asset semantics.** Worker startup failure is now the only bootstrap reason/notice/fallback case and the only bootstrap sub-case in task .6. cMap/standard-font 404s get their own failure-mode row and two executable checks: request attempted and 404-fulfilled; the outcome PDF.js actually produces captured first (verbatim console warnings and/or text-layer + pixel delta vs the clean run, or a classified page-render error if genuinely produced) then asserted against that capture; zero non-`self` requests; unchanged security headers/CSP; viewer actionable and never crashing; each case run twice with identical classification. No document-load fallback transition, `bootstrap` classification, or notice is required for them, and no page-error propagation architecture is invented — an unsurfaceable page error is reported as a finding instead. R8/R18 and the `"bootstrap"` definition sites were narrowed to match.

**P11 — branch metadata.** Spec JSON `branch_name` = `feat/native-pdf-renderer`; execution notes record that work continues on that existing branch with no branch created or switched, Flow ID unchanged. Grep confirmed no other artifact carries branch metadata.
